questions.q: Why can't the heartbeat be sent only from an EdgeTX widget's refresh()?
options: refresh() is called once per second
refresh() runs only when the widget is visible
There is no refresh() in EdgeTX
questions.explain: Hide the screen and the link is gone. Call a shared tick() from refresh() and background().

questions.q: What does serialRead() read with no argument?
questions.explain: A “one line = one message” protocol fits it naturally.

questions.q: The undefined state of a radio companion should be…
options: A reboot that waits for the radio
questions.explain: The access point comes up only after an explicit “disarmed” from the radio.

questions.q: How do you verifiably turn off Wi-Fi on an ESP32?
questions.explain: Turning it off must be an action, not an assumption.

questions.q: What should you check before connecting the radio's UART to the ESP32?
questions.explain: It is usually 3.3 V on both sides, but checking is mandatory.

questions.q: Where should the protection against writing settings in flight be?
questions.explain: Defense in depth: each side checks arm independently.

questions.q: Why is an onboard Wi-Fi bridge turned off in flight?
options: The module heats up inside the radio case
questions.explain: For setup on the ground it is acceptable.

questions.q: How does an ESP32 pass its own rangefinder to ArduPilot?
options: Through a PWM input of the flight controller
questions.explain: DISTANCE_SENSOR and RNGFND1_TYPE = 10 (MAVLink); the rangefinder is used by the EKF and landing.
